movable_parts.name: caster_wheel_roll
movable_parts.motion: Spins around its axle to allow the bed to roll forwards and backwards. There are four wheels (wheel1_01 to wheel4_01).

movable_parts.name: caster_wheel_swivel
movable_parts.motion: The entire wheel assembly rotates around a vertical axis to allow steering. There are four wheels (wheel1_01 to wheel4_01).

movable_parts.name: bed_height_adjustment
movable_parts.motion: The entire upper bed surface (bedtop_01) moves vertically to adjust the bed's height.

movable_parts.name: backrest_panel
movable_parts.motion: The backrest section (panelsection3_01) pivots upwards to raise the patient's torso.

movable_parts.name: knee_gatch_panel
movable_parts.motion: The panel under the patient's thighs (panelsection1_01) pivots upwards to bend the knees.

movable_parts.name: foot_panel
movable_parts.motion: The panel under the patient's calves (panelsection2_01) pivots to adjust the leg position.

movable_parts.name: side_rail
movable_parts.motion: The side rails (e.g., railelbow1_01, railelbow12_01) pivot downwards to allow access to the patient.
movable_parts.range_description: Pivots approximately 90 degrees from a vertical (up) to a horizontal (down) position.

movable_parts.name: foot_pedal
movable_parts.motion: Foot pedals (pedal1_01 to pedal7_01) are pressed to activate functions like braking or height adjustment.
movable_parts.range_description: Pivots down by 15-20 degrees when pressed.

movable_parts.name: iv_pole_telescope
movable_parts.motion: The inner pole (ivpole_pipe2_01) slides vertically to adjust the height of the IV hooks.

movable_parts.name: iv_pole_swivel
movable_parts.motion: The entire IV pole assembly (ivpole_01) can rotate at its base.

movable_parts.name: control_button
movable_parts.motion: Control buttons (bedtop_button1_01, bedtop_button2_01) depress slightly when pushed.

special_notes: Caster wheels have both swivel and roll axes. Bed articulation (height, backrest, leg sections) is driven by complex hydraulic mechanisms, which can be simplified as prismatic and revolute joints for simulation. The side rails have a multi-bar linkage but can be simplified to a single revolute joint.
